notes: The measurement was taken in the development checkout, which is shared with ten agent sessions: the load average was 34–50, so the absolute numbers are an upper bound and the ratios between the phases are the fact.

phases.name: detekt
phases.what: the analysis the verdict waits for — `:shared:detekt`, read-only

phases.name: auto-correct
phases.what: the same run with `--auto-correct` — what the verdict deliberately does not do, because it reads the tree it judges

phases.name: digest
phases.what: the content digest the verdict computes before and after the analysis (`git ls-files` plus `git hash-object` over every Kotlin file)

phases.name: together
phases.note: the global `./gw` slots were already taken, so the two modules were serialised — parallelism was not available on this host
phases.what: `:shared:detekt` and `:desktopApp:detekt` judged in ONE Gradle invocation — whether judging several modules costs less than judging them one after the other
